mentions.name: SignalSeek
mentions.description: SignalSeek monitors the Reddit subreddits where a user's buyers already hang out, scores the content it finds, and tells the user whether demand for an idea is real enough to build on. When demand checks out, it drafts replies so the user can jump straight into the conversation. It works as an idea validator built on Reddit and its API.
mentions.problem: The author was missing an "idea validator" that harnesses the power of Reddit and its content to confirm whether demand for an idea is genuine before building.
mentions.audience: Founders and makers deciding whether demand for a product idea is real enough to build on, by tapping the subreddits where their buyers already hang out.
mentions.source_excerpt:
recently, i have been pondering around reddit and its api, because i was missing an "idea validator" which will harness the power of reddit and its content, so it gave me the idea to build https://signalseek.cc/

(SignalSeek watches the subreddits your buyers already hang out in, scores what it finds, and tells you if the demand is real enough to build on. When it is, it drafts the replies so you can jump into the conversation right away)
mentions.author: sifik
